items.en: Tupolev says Tu-160M bomber rebuilt on 'entirely new technological base', with 80% of systems modernized
items.nl: Tupolev: Tu-160M-bommenwerper gebouwd op 'geheel nieuwe technologische basis', 80% van de systemen gemoderniseerd
items.sEn: Tupolev general director Yuri Abrosimov says the Tu-160M strategic bomber (NATO: Blackjack) keeps the outward silhouette of the Soviet-era Tu-160 but was "created on an entirely new technological base with active use of digital technologies", with 80% of its systems and equipment modernized, including avionics, naviga…

items.en: Satellite Images Reveal russian Tu-160Ms Being Armed with Kh-101 Missiles at Engels and Tu-95MS, Tu-22M3 Bomber Deployments at Olenya (Defense Express)

items.sEn: Defense Express reports on new satellite imagery published by the monitoring site AviVector showing Tu-160M strategic bombers being loaded with Kh-101 cruise missiles at Engels airbase. items.en: Russia builds the first three of 16 large bomber shelters, each about 63 x 63 m, at Engels-2 after repeated Ukrainian drone strikes (Defence Blog)
items.nl: Rusland bouwt de eerste drie van zestien grote bommenwerpershelters, elk circa 63 x 63 m, op Engels-2 na herhaalde Oekraïense droneaanvallen (Defence Blog)
items.sEn: Russia has nearly finished the steel frames of the first three of 16 planned large aircraft shelters at Engels-2 in Saratov Oblast, the main base of its strategic bomber fleet. Defence Blog reports this based on satellite imagery published by the open-source analysis group AviVector. An Airbus Defence and Space image…
items.sNl: Rusland heeft de stalen frames van de eerste drie van zestien geplande grote vliegtuigshelters op Engels-2 bijna af. items.en: Sanctions Push Russia's Aviation Industry Into Crisis, Forcing Rostec Restructuring
items.nl: Sancties drijven Russische luchtvaartindustrie in crisis, Rostec dwingt tot herstructurering
items.sEn: Ukrainian defense-news outlet Defense Express reports, citing Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU), that Western sanctions have pushed Russia's aviation industry into a structural crisis.
